plotEn:
High school student Laurel Hansen, her best friend Poppy Yang, and their classmates take a field trip to a park on Valentine's Day. The bridge the group stands on collapses, sending several students, including Park Ranger Pauline and parent chaperone Shannon, into the water below. They make it out of the water, and Laurel kisses her crush Leo, only to discover that he had been killed after being impaled by a wooden stake.
One year later, Laurel is no longer friends with Poppy and deals with anxiety from the incident and visions of her mother, Diane, dying in a house fire. 
Laurel begins dating her classmate Evan, whom she reconnected with after returning to school. One night, Laurel kisses Evan and has a vision of him and another classmate, Chuck, being stabbed to death. She tries to warn Randy Yang, the school principal and Poppy's father, but is dismissed. Diane cautions Laurel that she may be returned to Brookside, the mental hospital where she stayed after the accident.
Laurel attempts to solve the murder before it happens and reconciles with Poppy, who is now dating Shannon's son, Tyler. To convince Poppy of her power, Laurel kisses her, during which she sees Poppy dying of old age after saying the same words Diane does in her premonition. Laurel eliminates two other classmates named Zolly and Bree as suspects, but Evan ends their relationship after seeing Laurel kiss one of them.
